purpose: operational planning only; runtime information is never a scientific inclusion, controller-selection, safety, stopping, or redraw variable

historical_journal.controller_anonymization: first 12 hexadecimal characters of SHA256('Q2-OOS-V2-RUNTIME-ANON|' + source_commit + '|' + condition identity); the identity-to-hash map is not persisted
historical_journal.reader: dedicated allowlist-only reader constructs a new metadata record and immediately discards all source fields not explicitly allowed

reported_concentration: capped-row fraction of total elapsed time
longest 1% fraction of total elapsed time
longest 5% fraction of total elapsed time
longest 10% fraction of total elapsed time
historical_autopsy.correlation: Spearman and Pearson elapsed-seconds versus generated-token-count
historical_autopsy.controller_profile: anonymous paired MEDIUM+STRONG controller totals and cap rates; controller identity is the uncertainty unit

primary_views.FINITE_BANK_SUBSET: sample 16 of 31 paired controller profiles without replacement and sum complete MEDIUM+STRONG historical profile totals
primary_views.CONTROLLER_SUPERPOPULATION_BOOTSTRAP: sample 16 paired controller profiles with replacement and sum complete MEDIUM+STRONG historical profile totals

campaign_prior.hierarchical_within_controller: optional diagnostic using shell-stratified item/rollout elapsed rows within each selected profile; cannot replace paired-controller bootstrap
campaign_prior.finite_bank_exact_extrema: enumerate all C(31,16)=300,540,195 subset totals efficiently from 31 profile totals if practical; otherwise compute exact worst 16 as the 16 largest profile totals and label it descriptive

sensitivity.method: within each resampled controller profile and shell, replace the expected capped count among 600 rows by 600*min(multiplier*historical_shell_cap_rate,1); combine profile-specific capped and noncapped mean elapsed times; preserve shell asymmetry
sensitivity.interpretation: stress scenarios over controller-profile uncertainty, not calibrated probabilities of future capped propensity

safety_runtime_update_model.predictor: log1p total safety elapsed seconds over both shells for one controller
safety_runtime_update_model.target: log1p total full-panel elapsed seconds over both shells for the same historical controller
safety_runtime_update_model.model: ordinary least squares with intercept; no feature selection or refit after V2 safety
safety_runtime_update_model.qualification: SAFETY_RUNTIME_UPDATE_MODEL_QUALIFIED only if slope>0, LOOCV prediction Spearman>=0.40, and LOOCV RMSE<=0.90 times unconditional RMSE; otherwise SAFETY_RUNTIME_UPDATE_NOT_QUALIFIED_USE_UNCONDITIONAL_FORECAST
safety_runtime_update_model.post_safety_update_if_qualified: predict each selected controller's paired-shell total from its observed safety total; sum point predictions and form campaign uncertainty by residual bootstrap over historical controller-level LOOCV residuals with 100,000 draws
safety_runtime_update_model.post_safety_update_if_not_qualified: retain unconditional finite-bank and controller-superpopulation prior forecasts without conditioning on V2 controller safety runtime

balanced_schedule_order.key_set: all 16 controllers x 2 shells x 300 items x 2 rollouts; exact scientific keys and seeds remain unchanged
balanced_schedule_order.combination_index: c in [0,63] maps by mixed radix to controller=c mod16, shell=floor(c/16) mod2, rollout=floor(c/32) mod2
balanced_schedule_order.rounds: for q in [0,299] and slot in [0,63], c=(slot+17*q) mod64 and item=item_permutation[(q+37*c) mod300]
balanced_schedule_order.properties: 17 is coprime to 64; each 64-row round contains every controller-shell-rollout combination once; each combination visits every item exactly once; order is outcome-independent
balanced_schedule_order.audit: report min/max counts by controller, shell, rollout, unique-item coverage, and maximum imbalance at each prefix

online_eta.historical_tail_update: let ratio=observed aggregate mean generation seconds divided by the historical schedule-balanced expected prefix mean; w=min(completed/2048,1); scale=exp(w*log(ratio)); tail-aware remaining quantile=max(scale*prior full-campaign quantile - observed summed generation seconds,0)
